reviewMethod: Independent visual inspection of all eight original paper pages and scheme PDF pages 37–60, including every task, alternative method, graph, 50 marking components, attempt floor and special deduction. All 49 question and 49 complete solution crops visually inspected.
sourceNotes: Every paper page 1–8 and combined-scheme page 37–60 independently visually inspected; content is on paper pages 2–7 and scheme pages 40–56. Scheme 39 supplies general rules; 57 is Irish bonus guidance and 58–60 contain no further questions.
Q3(a) asks for both angles in one prompt: keep the task together with separate 5+5 controls. Every numbered subpart elsewhere has a separate card at its published allocation.
All original diagrams, tables, graphs, alternate workings and detailed deductions are retained. Shared solution panels explicitly identify the only marked part.
Q6 shared 17/20 examples concern four responses and a repeated error; no isolated five-mark card may award 17.
Q7 mean/standard-deviation allocations are 15/5, not reversed. Q8(a) source tolerances are unusually broad but retained exactly.
Q5(a) shared slip note gives B approximately 61 degrees, whereas arccos(8/17) is 61.93 degrees; the original note remains visible with a clarification.
